description: This file defines the ScaleImageEffect class, a Drupal plugin that scales images while maintaining aspect ratio, including configuration and validation methods.

classes.name: ScaleImageEffect
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that scales images while maintaining aspect ratio, extending ResizeImageEffect.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Scales the given image using configuration parameters; logs an error and returns FALSE if scaling fails.

methods.name: transformDimensions
methods.description: Adjusts image dimensions based on configuration if both width and height are specified.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary array for the image scale effect, including theme and configuration data.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings, including 'upscale' option.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the effect, including 'Allow Upscaling' checkbox.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring at least one of width or height is specified.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves the 'upscale' setting from the form into the configuration.
